findings.issue: כְּלָבִיא is morphologically a common noun of both genders (singular absolute); «leona» resolves that open gender as feminine.
חֲלָלִים is the pierced/slain (masculine plural); «heridos» can mean only the wounded.

notes: Pueblo, león, the 3ms verbs, presa, sangre, and beber match number, person, and stem.
